title: Occasional crash when jumping to previous location
body:
<!-- Your issue may already be reported!
Please search on the issue tracker before creating one. -->

### Reproduction steps

I am unsure how to reproduce other than: It happens occasionally when I `ctrl-o` to go back to a previous file. It may possibly happen more often on files I haven't edited for a little while?

### Environment

- Platform: Ubuntu 18 x86 Linux
- Helix version: v0.5.0-209-g35ac815 built from master

<details><summary>~/.cache/helix/helix.log</summary>
